result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, matching the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java` (around line 825). I changed the `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` on priority used by `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, followed by `opened_date, id`. I also updated the Javadoc to describe the new order. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest` and `TicketsPerSalesRepTest` pass offline. I did not add a test for the new ordering or run the example from the task, so the T-1 to T-5 case is covered only by reading the query. Nothing is committed.
